messages.subject: Polaris — escrow release reminder
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Unrelated to Quartz but while I remember: on Project Polaris (Kingsford/Larkfield) the £1.5m escrow release date is 30 April 2027 — I've diarised the bring-down and the warranty survival expiry. Castle & Vane have confirmed the retention account details haven't changed.

Nothing needed now; just flagging so it doesn't drop.

James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
+44 (0)20 7946 0048
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
